provider: CUHK Department of Japanese Studies 2025-26 Major Programme Requirement and Course List
note: The official 2025-26 Study Scheme publishes a 66-unit standard Major, a 66-unit Local Study Scheme, optional 72-unit Stream routes, a 51-unit senior-entry route and a 90-unit Japanese Studies and History double Major. The standard Major includes 9 Faculty Package units, 33 CUHK Required/Capstone units, 18 approved resident-study units in Japan and 6 JASP/external Elective units; a Stream raises the Elective requirement to 12 units. The Local Study Scheme replaces the 18 resident-study units with 24 local Elective units. This supplement exposes all 58 JASP codes that the Study Scheme assigns to the Japanese Studies Major, with current titles and per-course units closed by the Department's official Course List. It excludes seven JASP courses that appear only in the general Course List but not in the Major requirements: JASP1100, JASP1350, JASP1450, JASP1460, JASP1550, JASP2450 and JASP2460. Faculty Package choices and cross-department ANTH, ARTS, BMBL, CHES, CHLL, CURE, ENGE, FAAS, HIST, LING, MGNT, MUSC, PHIL, SOCI, THEO and TRAN Elective options are explicitly named by code in the Study Scheme but are not included here because the Japanese Studies Course List does not publish their titles and units. Approved exchange courses, placement-test substitutions, native-speaker substitutions, stream membership, external-course minima and the Japanese Studies and History double-Major path require manual review. The resulting JASP list is intentionally browse-only and must not be presented as a complete 66-unit graduation audit.
